deferrals.name: mcp
deferrals.reason: openhands-sdk 1.55.1 requires fastmcp>=3.2.0,<4, which requires mcp<2.0. Defer MCP 2.x until a supported SDK/fastmcp release removes that constraint.

deferrals.name: OSS_CAD_SUITE_RELEASE
deferrals.reason: The pinned suite tarball (now 2026-10-18) vendors python2.7/python3.11 site-packages carrying 6 upstream-borne CVEs (9 Trivy findings) that no in-repo change can fix; they are waived in .trivyignore until 2027-01-03. Adopt newest dated release each sweep and re-scan.

Latest stable is 3.15, but the sdk-check group's openhands-sdk->litellm->fastuuid chain pins fastuuid 0.14.0 (sdist only, no cp315 wheel) and its bundled PyO3 fails to build on 3.15. pydantic-core has shipped cp315 wheels as of 2.50.1, so fastuuid is the sole blocker - re-check when fastuuid publishes a 3.15-capable release.
